papeleta.title: Papeleta
papeleta.problem: Simplify digital invitation creation and event planning through a single platform.
papeleta.solution: Collaborative development of a Full Stack platform with customizable invitations, guest management and RSVPs.

balance.title: Balance App
balance.problem: Organize shared household expenses and track who paid, how much each person owes and what remains outstanding.
balance.solution: I built a Full Stack application with households, expense splitting, approvals and transaction history. It combines authentication, PostgreSQL, SQL/RPC operations and RLS policies to control data access.

anthropology.title: College of Anthropologists
anthropology.problem: Digitize professional registration and administrative requests to centralize information and simplify tracking.
anthropology.solution: I built a platform with authentication, an admin dashboard, professional information management and request status tracking. It includes a public professional directory.

jujuyConecta.title: Jujuy Conecta
jujuyConecta.problem: Manage daily news publishing with a lightweight, independent platform rather than a general-purpose CMS.
jujuyConecta.solution: I built a digital newspaper with a custom CMS and technical SEO, combining editorial work with news workflow automation.

highlights.automation: Scraping and publishing with Python and GitHub Actions.

tierraArcilla.title: Self-Managed Digital Catalog – Tierra Arcilla
tierraArcilla.problem: A local entrepreneur needed to digitize her inventory to share it on WhatsApp, but traditional CMS platforms (WordPress/Tiendanube) were costly and difficult to maintain.
tierraArcilla.solution: I built a self-managed web application with an admin dashboard, bulk product uploads via CSV, a real-time database and dynamic metadata to improve product previews when shared on WhatsApp.

thesis.title: Fernanda Herrera
thesis.problem: Present the academic consulting service on a trustworthy website that makes navigation and inquiries easier.
thesis.solution: I built a professional website with responsive interfaces and a focus on UX/UI, performance, accessibility and SEO. It integrates Supabase and organizes the service information.
